# Every one of those 1,000.00 US dollars sold at 1.40, against the cost basis
# the purchase opened.
#
# The sale values the dollars at what they cost — 1,300.00 CAD — and the CAD
# bank takes the 1,400.00 they fetched, so `$residual$` takes the 100.00
# between them. That is the convention every disposal in this format follows,
# and it is what makes the residual split the realized gain.
#
# At the year end the book holds no US dollars, so nothing is unrealized and
# the whole 100.00 is realized.
#
# `{usd_basis}` is the guid of the purchase's cost basis, read from
# `fx-balances` after the first import.
2026-06-01 * "Sell every dollar at 1.40"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-1300.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{usd_basis}"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1400.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
